title: Nebraska AI Laws

reading.body:
Nebraska's only AI-related law is a conversational AI safety statute bundled with agricultural data privacy, passed April 17, 2026.

The pattern here is consolidation rather than a standalone AI act. LB525 creates two separate regimes in one bill: the Agricultural Data Privacy Act, which gives producers ownership of data from their farm, land, devices, and equipment and bars sale of it without express written consent, and the Conversational Artificial Intelligence Safety Act, which places disclosure, content prevention, privacy tool, and crisis protocol duties on operators of conversational AI services, with particular attention to minor account holders. The bill also amends the public records law so agricultural data can be withheld absent prior written consent from its owner.

For AI specifically, the operative obligations fall on conversational services and their operators, not on model training or on the compute that trains models. The duties are behavioral and user-facing: disclose, prevent certain content, provide privacy tools, run crisis protocols. That is a consumer protection frame, and it reaches the deployed chatbot rather than the data center behind it.

What this does not tell the reader is how the duties are enforced, what penalties attach, which operators fall inside the definition of a conversational AI service, or when the obligations take effect. The data covers one law, so it says nothing about Nebraska's posture on training data, model evaluation, or AI in state government. One law is also too thin a base for any claim about a trend.

Nebraska has enacted 1 AI-related law. Each is read from its enrolled text: what it does, who it applies to, when it takes effect, and what it requires.

Enacted AI laws in Nebraska

1 law this site judged relevant to AI, newest first, each read from its enrolled text.

  • LB525: Adopt the Agricultural Data Privacy Act and the Conversational Artificial Intelligence Safety Act passed 2026-04-17

    The law adopts the Agricultural Data Privacy Act, which gives agricultural producers ownership and control of agricultural data originating from their farm, land, devices, and equipment, and prohibits controllers and processors from selling that data without express written consent while requiring reasonable data security. It also adopts the Conversational Artificial Intelligence Safety Act, which imposes disclosure, content prevention, privacy tool, and crisis protocol duties on operators of conversational artificial intelligence services, especially for minor account holders. It amends the public records law to allow withholding agricultural data absent prior written consent from the owner.

How this page is kept

This page is generated from the enacted laws this site tracks for Nebraska. When the legislature passes another AI-related bill, it appears here the night the bill's text is read. The full 50-state picture is at State AI Laws.
